blocks.text:
Many aspects of the look of widgets are controlled by CSS (Cascading Style
Sheet) files. With CSS files you can choose color, font, line thickness, etc.
If you give some widgets their own names or their own CSS classes, you can define
CSS rules that apply only to those widgets, for instance certain buttons,
without affecting other similar widgets.
blocks.zh: 部件外观的许多方面由 CSS（层叠样式表）文件控制。用 CSS 文件可以选择颜色、字体、线条粗细等。如果给某些部件指定自己的名称或自己的 CSS 类，就可以定义只作用于这些部件的 CSS 规则，例如某些按钮，而不影响其他类似的部件。

blocks.text: CSS Node Name, Widget Name, CSS Class Name
There are three ways of referring from a widget to data in a CSS file:
blocks.zh: 从部件引用 CSS 文件中的数据有三种方式：

blocks.text:
gtk_widget_class_set_css_name()
    can only be called from the class init function. It sets the CSS node name
    of all instances of a class (a GType). See the [
    Class Init and Instance Init Functions](#custom-init-functions) section.
blocks.zh: gtk_widget_class_set_css_name() 只能在类初始化函数中调用，它为一个类（一个 GType）的所有实例设置 CSS 节点名。参见[类初始化与实例初始化函数](#custom-init-functions)一节。

blocks.text:
Gtk::Widget::set_name()
    can be called from a C++ constructor. It sets the name of
    a widget instance.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Widget::set_name() 可以在 C++ 构造函数中调用，它设置某个部件实例的名称。

blocks.text:
Gtk::Widget::add_class_name()
    can be called from a C++ constructor. It adds the name of a CSS class,
    used by a widget instance.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Widget::add_class_name() 可以在 C++ 构造函数中调用，它添加某个部件实例所使用的 CSS 类名。

blocks.text:
The following example shows a button with its own CSS node name, a label with
a widget name and a label that uses its own CSS class.
blocks.zh: 下面的示例展示了一个有自己 CSS 节点名的按钮、一个有部件名称的标签，以及一个使用自己 CSS 类的标签。

blocks.text: Custom Style Information

To add a style sheet to an application, use one of the
Gtk::CssProvider::load_from_*() methods.
Then add it with Gtk::StyleProvider::add_provider_for_display()
(available since gtkmm 4.10) or Gtk::StyleContext::add_provider_for_display().
`Gtk::StyleContext` also contains methods to read some style
information, but this class is deprecated since gtkmm 4.10.
blocks.zh: 要给应用程序添加样式表，使用某个 Gtk::CssProvider::load_from_*() 方法，然后用 Gtk::StyleProvider::add_provider_for_display()（自 gtkmm 4.10 起可用）或 Gtk::StyleContext::add_provider_for_display() 添加。`Gtk::StyleContext` 还包含读取某些样式信息的方法，但这个类自 gtkmm 4.10 起已弃用。

blocks.text: CSS files are described in the documentation of GTK.
blocks.zh: CSS 文件在 GTK 的文档中有说明。

blocks.zh: 这个示例实现了一个按钮和两个带自定义样式信息的标签。
